run.question: What collections exist in the database? Then look at the transactions collection and tell me the verification code for the failed transaction.

report.summary: The configured MongoDB database (shopdb) contains three collections: customers, products and transactions. Scanning transactions (estimated 5 documents, 5 returned) showed exactly one document with status "failed": order ORD-10443, amount 324, payment_method credit_card, failure_reason "payment gateway timeout", created_at 2025-11-03T09:45:00, verification_code "HMNG-227-k7x2p9". The other four documents are completed (ORD-10441, ORD-10442, ORD-10444) and pending (ORD-10445), and none of them carries a verification_code or failure_reason field in the returned projection. Caveat: this is the collection as read at query time, and the failed record's own created_at (2025-11-03) lies well before the authorized window start (2026-10-24), so the record is application data, not evidence of anything that happened inside the incident window.
